issue_context.title: Editor's root viewport serves stale images after the first access for ViewportTexture
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please search existing issues for potential duplicates before filing yours:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues?q=is%3Aissue
-->

**Godot version:**
4.0 #4c528e7


**OS/device including version:**
Windows 10


**Issue description:**
Attempting to capture an editor screenshot with an editor plugin (GDScript) doesn't produce the desired result. The first time you try to get the image from the root `SubViewport`'s `ViewportTexture`, it is returned as expected. However, all consecutive attempts return the same exact image, even though the code even waits for two frames (as is tradition) before grabbing the picture:

```gdscript
	var editor_tree = get_editor_interface().get_base_control().get_tree()
	await editor_tree.process_frame
	await editor_tree.process_frame
	
	var base_control = get_editor_interface().get_base_control()
	var main_viewport = (base_control.get_tree().get_root() as Viewport)
	var viewport_image = main_viewport.get_texture().get_data()
	
	var datetime = OS.get_unix_time()
	viewport_image.save_png("res://.output/godot-editor-" + str(datetime) + ".png")
```

Same does not happen with a user project though, and the image is captured correctly.

```gdscript
	var image = $SubViewportContainer/SubViewport.get_texture().get_data()
	var datetime = OS.get_unix_time()
	image.save_png("res://.output/output-" + str(datetime) + ".png")
```

**Steps to reproduce:**
See the code above and demo projects.

**Minimal reproduction project:**
Editor plugin (press F11 to capture):
[plugin-editor-screenshotter-4.0.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/5966876/plugin-editor-screenshotter-4.0.zip)

User project (press the on screen button to capture):
[bug-viewport-screenshot.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/5966890/bug-viewport-screenshot.zip)
